topic: 生活方式与观点支持 · Independent new scenario: a workplace adapting to an energy constraint
grammarFocus: 原因、结果与让步从句；may / might / can 的语气差别。 Teach the new rule in Chinese, then provide at least 8 distinct grammar questions in new sentences. Distinguish a newly taught form from revision. All main reading/listening question prompts and options must be English, with short A0/A1 English prompts. Chinese explanations are allowed. Preserve a coherent new scenario; do not rename an earlier text, reuse its facts or reveal answers in question stems.
sourcePolicy: Project-original scenario; simulated figures and people; no copied official test, textbook, GitHub PDF or third-party audio.
title: The Office Energy Challenge
instructions: 这是为B1–B2成人学习者设计的原创模拟听力材料（非官方雅思测试，也不代表任何分数）。先阅读中文语法讲解，再听/读对话，完成10道题。听力部分有自然的口语修正和干扰信息，答案不会直接读出。所有题目和选项均为英文，解释为中文。建议先做题，再看解释和证据。
transcript:
Maya: Hi, everyone. Thanks for coming. As you know, the company has a new energy rule. We must cut electricity use by 20 percent this month. I know it's hard, but we can do it.
Tom: Sorry, Maya, can I ask something? Why this month? Is it because of the hot weather?
Maya: Good question. The main reason is that our energy costs went up a lot last year. So the company wants to save money. Also, the government may give a reward to green offices.
Tom: I see. So if we use less power, we might get some money back?
Maya: Exactly. But we don't have to do anything dangerous. We can still work comfortably.
Lisa: I have an idea. We could turn off the lights near the windows. The sun is very bright in the afternoon.
Maya: That's a great idea, Lisa. We can do that. But please don't turn off the lights in the hallway. It's dark there, and people might fall.
Tom: What about the air conditioning? Can we turn it off?
Maya: Hmm, we may not turn it off completely. It's very hot today. But we can set it to 26 degrees. That saves a lot of energy.
Tom: OK. And the printers? They use power when we are not using them.
Maya: Yes, they do. So we should turn them off at night. But wait—I mean, we can turn them off at night, but not during the day. Some people need to print.
Lisa: What about the coffee machine? It's always on.
Maya: Good point. The coffee machine can stay on during work hours. But we might turn it off after 6 p.m. Actually, let's turn it off after 6. It's not a big problem.
Tom: So, to sum up: lights off near windows, AC at 26, printers off at night, coffee machine off after 6. Is that right?
Maya: Yes, that's right. And one more thing: if we save energy, the company may give us a small bonus. But I'm not sure yet. It's only a possibility.
Lisa: Even if we don't get a bonus, it's good for the environment.
Maya: True. Although it's a small change, it can make a big difference. Thanks, everyone.

grammar.title: 原因、结果与让步从句；may / might / can 的语气差别
grammar.explanation: 原因从句用 because / since / as 说明理由，例如 because energy costs went up。结果从句用 so / that's why 说明结果。让步从句用 although / even if / though 表示“虽然、即使”，主句仍然成立。may 表示“可能”（较正式、可能性中等），might 表示“也许”（可能性稍低或更不确定），can 表示“能够/可以”（能力或许可），不是猜测。注意：may not 是“可能不”，can't 是“不能”。
grammar.example: Although it's a small change, it can make a big difference.

questions.prompt: Choose the best word: ______ the office is small, it uses a lot of power.
questions.explanation: 前后是让步关系：虽然办公室小，但用电多。用Although。
questions.evidence: Although it's a small change, it can make a big difference.

questions.prompt: Choose the best word: We turned off the lights ______ we wanted to save energy.
questions.evidence: The main reason is that our energy costs went up a lot last year.

questions.prompt: Choose the best word: It was very hot, ______ we opened the windows.
questions.explanation: 前面是原因，后面是结果，用so。
questions.evidence: So the company wants to save money.

questions.prompt: Which sentence shows a possibility, not an ability?
options: We can turn off the lights.
questions.explanation: might表示可能性；can表示能力或许可。
questions.evidence: But we might turn it off after 6 p.m.

questions.prompt: Choose the best word: The government ______ give us a reward, but I'm not sure.
questions.explanation: 表示不确定的可能性，用may。
questions.evidence: Also, the government may give a reward to green offices.

questions.prompt: Choose the best word: ______ we don't get the bonus, we will still save energy.
questions.evidence: Even if we don't get a bonus, it's good for the environment.

questions.prompt: Which sentence means 'it is possible that we will not turn it off completely'?
options: We may not turn it off completely.
We can't turn it off completely.
We must not turn it off completely.
answers: We may not turn it off completely.
questions.explanation: may not表示“可能不”；can't表示“不能”；must not表示“禁止”。
questions.evidence: We may not turn it off completely.

questions.prompt: Choose the best word: She was tired, ______ she finished the report.
questions.explanation: 前后是让步关系：虽然累，但还是完成了报告。
questions.evidence: Although it's a small change, it can make a big difference.
